The problem is that the running pods still use the previously cached build, despite the tag being the same. This suggests that Kubernetes or the container runtime might be caching the image, or that the deployment hasn't been instructed to check for a new image even if the tag is the same.

To force the deployment to pull the new image without changing the tag, I can force a rollout by updating the deployment template spec with a dummy change.
